entry_state: Joint conversion changes the threshold bonus and tax, so isolated earnings increments need not add. The four hypothetical worlds remain calculable while final nonadditive selection is unevaluated. Contingent options also require the stated similar-instrument prerequisite. A separate participating-dividend case now introduces a hypothetical tax benefit allocated to ordinary holders.
exit_state: Participating-dividend tax benefits enter the EPS allocation without creating hypothetical ledger entries. Signed residual adjustments prevent counting earlier earnings benefits twice. The argument now turns to a separate consolidation book, dated control findings and conditional group perimeters; percentage ownership alone does not establish control.
